page_title: NOR 1-2 ENG | Norway v England 11/07/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 120+3' The referee blows his whistle to end the second period of extra-time.
119' Flag goes up against Antonio Nusa (Norway) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
117' The main referee, Clement Turpin, is apparently not going to tolerate any discussions. Kristoffer Ajer (Norway) is given a yellow card for dissent.

117' Martin Odegaard (Norway) attempts to find one of his teammates with a ball from a free kick outside the box. The goalkeeper climbs high above all the players in the box to intercept the cross and snuff out the opportunity.
116' Referee Clement Turpin sees the trip by Reece James (England) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle. Norway will take a free kick near the side line.
116' Elliot Anderson (England) commits a rough challenge and Clement Turpin blows his whistle for a foul.
115' The attendance is 64478.
114' Oscar Bobb (Norway) covers his face with his hands after wasting a promising chance. He takes the rebound on the edge of the box but blazes the ball high over the crossbar.
114' The corner from Martin Odegaard (Norway) is hurriedly cleared.

114' Antonio Nusa (Norway) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety. The ball is out of play and Norway manage to earn a corner.
111' It is time for a substitution. Dan Burn (England) is on for Jude Bellingham.
110' Bukayo Saka (England) is first to latch onto the rebound inside the penalty area. He sends a shot towards the right post, but it is denied by the goalkeeper with a superb save.
110' A snap shot by Djed Spence (England) from the edge of the area flies towards the bottom right corner, but Orjan Nyland produces a good save to thwart him.
109' Bukayo Saka (England) dribbles his way to the edge of the box and drills a shot low towards the middle of the goal, but Orjan Nyland is equal to the effort and makes a good save.
109' Patrick Berg (Norway) neatly controls a driven pass on the edge of the box, glances up and cracks a beautiful drive goalwards that sails just over the bar.
107' Bukayo Saka (England) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
106' Clement Turpin couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Sander Berge (Norway) and blew his whistle.
106' The substitution is prepared. Jorgen Larsen (Norway) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Erling Haaland.
106' The second period of extra-time has just started.
105+4' The first period of extra time has ended and the second period will start shortly after the break.
105+3' That's a well-taken pass by Jude Bellingham (England). He unleashes a strike from the edge of the box, but blazes it high over the bar.
105+2' Flag up against Eberechi Eze (England). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
105' Fredrik Aursnes (Norway) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Jordan Pickford intercepts the ball.
104' Patrick Berg (Norway) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.

104' The defence had a hard time blocking out the strike from Antonio Nusa (Norway). He didn't hesitate and finished from outside the box right after he had received a pass from his teammate. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Norway.
102' The England players are stunned as the referee changes his mind following the VAR review. NO PENALTY.
101' Celebrations by England are cut short as the referee signals that the penalty decision will be checked using the VAR. Hopefully it won’t take too long.
99' Clement Turpin blows his whistle after Oscar Bobb (Norway) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle. Penalty! A huge opportunity to score for England.
96' The Norway players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.
93' 1 - 2 Goal! Jude Bellingham (England) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low into the middle of the net. It's 1:2.

93' Morgan Rogers (England) latches onto a pass and lets rip with a swerving shot from long range towards the middle of the goal. It's a difficult effort to deal with and Orjan Nyland does well to punch it away.
93' Orjan Nyland makes a superb save to deny a header which was nodded towards the right-hand post by Harry Kane (England) after a cross from the side.
92' Bukayo Saka (England) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
92' Bukayo Saka (England) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball is out of play. England will have a chance to score from a corner.
91' Substitution. Torbjorn Lysaker Heggem (Norway) is replaced by Leo Ostigard.
91' Full time failed to determine the winner and we needed to wait for extra time. Clement Turpin starts it right now!
90+9' The second half has finished, but the result of this match is still yet to be decided.
90+5' Torbjorn Lysaker Heggem (Norway) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
90+5' Jude Bellingham (England) climbs high to connect with a cross near the penalty spot but plants a header well wide of the left post.
90+3' Looks like Torbjorn Lysaker Heggem (Norway) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
90+2' Patrick Berg (Norway) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Clement Turpin blows his whistle for a foul.
90' There will be a minimum of 7 min. of added time.
90' Stale Solbakken decides to make a substitution. David Wolfe will be replaced by Marcus Pedersen (Norway).
89' A substitution has been made. Ezri Konsa goes off and Morgan Rogers (England) comes on.
89' The foul by Harry Kane (England) was seen by Clement Turpin who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
88' The corner from Eberechi Eze (England) is intercepted by the defence.
88' Ezri Konsa (England) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. England earn a corner.
87' Bukayo Saka (England) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance.
86' Substitution. Nico O'Reilly will be replaced by Djed Spence (England).

85' Antonio Nusa (Norway) receives a low pass just outside the box and drills a fine strike towards the middle of the goal. Jordan Pickford pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed.
83' Patrick Berg (Norway) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
82' Antonio Nusa (Norway) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Norway.
78' Bukayo Saka (England) plays in a hopeful cross, but it doesn't find its way to any of the attacking players.
76' Erling Haaland (Norway) latches onto a rebound in the box and fires a shot a whisker wide of the left post. That was a promising chance and maybe he should have done better!
76' Kristoffer Ajer (Norway) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his header from the six-yard box wasn't accurate enough and the ball glanced away off the bar!
76' Patrick Berg (Norway) sends the corner into the box, but Jordan Pickford intercepts it and averts the threat.
75' The ball is cleared after Antonio Nusa (Norway) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The referee points to the corner flag and Norway will take a corner.
74' Oscar Bobb (Norway) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
71' We are about to witness a subsitution. Reece James (England) for Anthony Gordon.
68' A cooling break is underway.
68' Stale Solbakken has decided to make a change. Antonio Nusa (Norway) replaces Andreas Schjelderup.
68' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Oscar Bobb (Norway) is coming onto the pitch as Alexander Sorloth cannot continue after picking up an injury.
65' Sander Berge (Norway) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Clement Turpin blows for a foul.
62' 6:6 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
60' Stale Solbakken is forced to make a change. Julian Ryerson (Norway) is unable to continue due to injury, Fredrik Aursnes comes on.
59' Julian Ryerson (Norway) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
58' Martin Odegaard (Norway) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
57' Here comes the VAR verdict. NO GOAL for Norway due to a foul in the build-up play.
56' The Norway players halt their celebrations as referee Clement Turpin makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was a foul in the build-up play.
55' Goal! Torbjorn Lysaker Heggem (Norway) fires the rebound into the roof of the net after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 2:1.

55' Jordan Pickford makes a sensational save to thwart a great chance. A rebound falls to Patrick Berg (Norway) inside the box and he strikes goalwards, but the ball ends up in the keeper's gloves instead of the left side of the target.
54' Julian Ryerson (Norway) takes the corner which is cleared.

53' Erling Haaland (Norway) attempts to convert a cross into a goal, but his promising header from near the penalty spot towards the bottom left corner is denied by a decent save from Jordan Pickford. Norway have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
53' Martin Odegaard (Norway) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.

52' Alexander Sorloth (Norway) sends a chip pass into the box, but Jordan Pickford is quickest to intercept the ball. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Norway.
51' That's unlucky! Bukayo Saka (England) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared.
48' Eberechi Eze (England) fires the ball in from a mid-range free kick, but it blazes over the bar.
46' Clement Turpin blows his whistle after Sander Berge (Norway) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball. England are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
46' Half-time substitution. Thomas Tuchel decided to make a change. Declan Rice (England) is replaced by Eberechi Eze.
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Noni Madueke (England) comes off for Bukayo Saka.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+5' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+4' Harry Kane (England) has a goal ruled out for offside!

45+3' Harry Kane (England) gets into a good scoring position. He creates some space for himself and tries his luck from distance. His decent effort towards the bottom left corner is, however, superbly saved by Orjan Nyland!

45+2' 1 - 1 Goal! Anthony Gordon shows great vision to find Jude Bellingham (England) with a cheeky pass inside the box, and his first-time shot is precise and sails into the bottom right corner. 1:1.
45' 4 additional min. will be played.
45' Declan Rice (England) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
45' Declan Rice (England) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.

44' A lofted cross from Noni Madueke (England) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area. The ball goes behind for a corner. England will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
44' Alexander Sorloth (Norway) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
42' Julian Ryerson (Norway) makes a strong challenge and Clement Turpin blows for a foul.

40' Martin Odegaard (Norway) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went towards the bottom right corner, but Jordan Pickford was alert and the score remained the same.
39' Unlucky! A great strike from Alexander Sorloth (Norway) near the edge of the box had the keeper scrambling but flew just over the bar.
39' Clement Turpin blows his whistle and it's Anthony Gordon (England) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
37' Here comes the VAR decision. The goal is given and Norway players have a reason to celebrate!
36' Wait! Referee Clement Turpin has indicated he is going to review the Norway goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was a foul in the build-up.

36' 1 - 0 Martin Odegaard looks around to decide who he is going to pass to. He picks out Andreas Schjelderup (Norway), who collects the ball perfectly and unleashes a terrific shot from just outside of the box towards the top right corner and it ricochets in off the post. The score is 1:0.
35' What a save from Jordan Pickford! Erling Haaland (Norway) jumps high to meet a cross and glances a promising header from close range, but the goalkeeper pulls off a brilliant stop to keep it out.
34' Norway are seeing far more of the ball now.
32' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Declan Rice (England), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders.
32' Julian Ryerson (Norway) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Clement Turpin blows his whistle for a foul. England earn a free kick.
31' A pass from Martin Odegaard (Norway) is intercepted by Jordan Pickford and the move breaks down.
29' Harry Kane (England) fails to convert a close-range free kick as he sends the ball narrowly over the bar.
28' Clement Turpin has a clear sight and sees a foul from Kristoffer Ajer (Norway). England win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
23' The referee blows his whistle and players are going to refresh themselves.
21' England keep possession of the ball with some short passes, waiting for the moment to hit the opposition swiftly on the break.
19' Jude Bellingham (England) climbs high to connect with a cross near the penalty spot but plants a header well wide of the right post.
18' A cross into the box from Anthony Gordon (England) is cleared.
16' Declan Rice (England) takes the corner but it's cleared.
16' Anthony Gordon (England) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. England have a corner.
14' The ratio of the ball possession is 39:61.
11' Noni Madueke (England) clearly handles the ball, but he is surprised when the referee blows his whistle.
8' Sander Berge (Norway) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Clement Turpin blows his whistle for a foul.
7' The linesman signals that Noni Madueke (England) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
5' Orjan Nyland steps in and intercepts a long pass from Harry Kane (England).
2' Noni Madueke (England) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it.
1' The match has just started.
Norway will kick-off.
Clement Turpin was nominated as the referee for this game.
